name: green-marker-at-price-na
note: An `na` price DROPS the marker rather than drawing it somewhere invented. `ta.pivothigh` is na on every bar it has not confirmed a pivot, which is most of them -- so this is the COMMON case for the liquidity-pivot markers, not an edge case, and a fallback price would scatter glyphs across the chart at a fabricated level. Matches the existing rule that a dynamic colour resolving to na hides a marker (Pine color=na). Here left=1/right=1 confirms a pivot only at bar 2 (high 13 is a strict local max, confirmed one bar later), so exactly one marker survives -- at bar 2, carrying that pivot's value.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, 1, 1)
plotshape(true, "Pivot", shape=shape.circle, location=location.absolute, price=ph, color=color.red, size=size.small)
